# Preface {.unnumbered}

This book documents the development of a multifamily rating scorecard
following the Federal Reserve's *Supervisory Guidance on Model Risk
Management* ([SR 11-7](https://www.federalreserve.gov/supervisionreg/srletters/sr1107a1.pdf)).
The model is built on Fannie Mae's Multifamily Loan Performance Data and
exists to illustrate the model development process, not for use.

Each chapter covers one stage of development. The code that produces every
table and figure is in the `mf_scorecard` package in this repository and can
be shown inline with the "Show code" toggles.

To rebuild the book, first build the database (see the README), then run:

```sh
uv run --group docs quarto render docs
```
